title: Smoke test technical approach with Amazon (Christelle Ngambula) using synthetic data set

payload.spec:
## What

Work with Christelle Ngambula (ngambula@amazon.es) at Amazon to smoke test the end-to-end technical approach (normalization → hashing → partitioning → delivery format) using a **synthetic** dataset, rather than real UK PII.

## Why

Validates the AIP export pipeline and format against Amazon's actual matching infrastructure without waiting on the outstanding legal/compliance gates (Legal/GDPR review, DPA, WINR contract permission — see `REQUIREMENTS.md` Section 3 and Section 10). A synthetic-data smoke test can de-risk the technical integration in parallel with those approvals, rather than being blocked by them.

## Scope

- [ ] Agree with Christelle on the synthetic dataset format/shape (record count, field coverage — ideally mirroring the real schema in `sql/04-amazon-pii-export.sql` / `sql/05-amazon-ipv4-export.sql`)
- [ ] Generate the synthetic dataset (no real PII) through the existing normalization UDFs (`sql/03-amazon-normalization-udfs.sql`)
- [ ] Export to Parquet via the existing pipeline (`sql/06-export-to-parquet.sql`) and confirm partition structure matches Amazon's confirmed spec (`source={provider_name}/spine={spine}/country=gb/date=YYYY-MM-DD/`)
- [ ] Deliver to Amazon via an agreed transport (transport mechanism itself is still undecided — see the "Transport (undecided)" block in `docs/diagrams/amazon-uk-identity-pipeline.d2`)
- [ ] Confirm with Amazon/Christelle Ngambula that the file format, hashing, and partitioning are ingested correctly on their end
- [ ] Document findings/discrepancies back into `EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md` or this issue

## Related

- Complements #8 (real, stratified UK sample) — that issue is about sampling dentsu's actual population for the eventual real test; this issue is about proving the pipeline/format works at all, using synthetic (non-PII) data, independent of legal clearance on real data.
- Blocked items tracked in `README.md` (AWS provider name/account ID, EU-region S3 path) may also apply here if Amazon requires the same onboarding details even for a synthetic smoke test — confirm with Christelle whether a lighter-weight delivery path exists for test data.
